correctness.rationale: The common-uniform monotone rounding coupling gives E|R(a,U)-R(b,U)|=|a-b|, hence W1 contraction q and unique invariant law. Conditional unbiased innovation and periodic psi identity give (1-q²)V=E psi(2theta+(1-q)(X-theta)) and a uniform O(sqrt(1-q)) phase error. The two-sided martingale-array representation has negligible q^N remainder, vanishing maximal increments and predictable variance converging in L1 to psi(2theta), proving the stationary normal limit. The closed {0,1} transition matrix proves the exact theta=1/2 stationary exception; conditional mean -qZ yields all lag covariances. An independent exact-rational stationary calculation checked 9 rational theta,q parameter pairs (including resonance) and 9 phase-bound comparisons; the Gaussian limit is not inferred from these finite checks.
